crossRefs.note: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”
But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.
The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

parallels.note: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”

translations.web: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”
translations.bsb: They began to be grieved and to ask Him one after another, “Surely not I?”
translations.kjv: And they began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I? and another said, Is it I?
translations.asv: They began to be sorrowful, and to say unto him one by one, Is it I?
